description: Use multiple Claude Code accounts in VS Code: switch per window or per repository, see each account's plan and usage limits, and move to another account when one hits its limit. Shared or isolated profiles, optional shared history.
untrusted.description: In Restricted Mode, workspace settings cannot change when accounts are applied or when the window reloads.
virtual.description: Accounts are folders on disk, so virtual workspaces are not supported.
cmd.continueInTerminal: Continue latest conversation in terminal as account
cmd.setRepoDefault: Set default account for this repository
cmd.clearRepoDefault: Clear default account for this repository
cmd.toggleHistorySharing: Share / stop sharing history across accounts
cmd.toggleLiveQuota: Turn live quota on or off
walkthrough.title: Get started with multiple Claude Code accounts
walkthrough.description: Add your accounts, choose which one each repository uses, and keep working when one hits its usage limit.
walkthrough.add.title: Add an account
walkthrough.add.description:
Each account is a separate Claude Code configuration folder. Your original ~/.claude stays as the Default account.
[Add account](command:claudeAccounts.add)
walkthrough.login.title: Log in
walkthrough.login.description:
Log in once per account. A terminal opens with that account's environment.
[Log in](command:claudeAccounts.login)
walkthrough.switch.title: Switch accounts
walkthrough.switch.description:
Click the account in the status bar, use the Claude Accounts view in the Explorer, or press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+A (Cmd+Alt+Shift+A on macOS) to go back to the previous account.
[Switch account](command:claudeAccounts.switch)
walkthrough.defaults.title: Pick an account per repository
walkthrough.defaults.description:
Set a default for this repository, or a rule for a whole folder or GitHub organization.
[Set default for this repository](command:claudeAccounts.setRepoDefault)
[Add a rule](command:claudeAccounts.addRule)
walkthrough.limits.title: Keep working at the usage limit
walkthrough.limits.description:
When an account hits its limit, the extension offers the account with the most quota left. Turn on live quota to see the 5-hour and weekly usage of each account, and shared history to continue the same conversation.
[Turn on live quota](command:claudeAccounts.toggleLiveQuota)
[Share history](command:claudeAccounts.toggleHistorySharing)
walkthrough.diagnose.title: Check that everything works
walkthrough.diagnose.description:
Diagnose shows which account each part of VS Code uses, runs "claude auth status" for every account and lists anything that needs fixing.
[Diagnose](command:claudeAccounts.diagnose)
cfg.scope: Where the selected account is remembered.
cfg.scope.workspace: Each window/repository remembers its own account (extension storage; nothing is written to the repository).
cfg.scope.user: A single account for every window (each window picks it up when reloaded).
cfg.reloadBehavior: What to do after switching accounts. The Claude Code extension only reads the account when the window loads.
cfg.reloadBehavior.ask: Ask whether to reload the window.
cfg.reloadBehavior.never: Do not reload; the status bar shows that a reload is pending.
cfg.autoApplyRepoDefault: When a repository is opened, automatically apply the default account set for it or matched by a rule.
cfg.rules: Default-account rules, checked in order when no default is set for the specific repository. A pattern starting with `~`, `/` or a drive letter matches the folder path (e.g. `~/work/**`); anything else matches the git remote (e.g. `github.com/my-company/*`). Without wildcards, a pattern also matches everything below it. `account` is the account id, name or e-mail. [Add a rule](command:claudeAccounts.addRule)
cfg.statusBarStyle: How the current account appears in the status bar.
cfg.statusBarStyle.name: Icon and full name, e.g. Claude: Work.
cfg.showPlan: Show the account's plan (e.g. Pro, Max 20x) in the status bar and the account picker, when Claude Code provides it.
cfg.showQuota: Show the usage of the current limit window in the status bar, when [live quota](command:claudeAccounts.toggleLiveQuota) is on.
cfg.onUsageLimit: What to do when the current account hits its usage limit in this window.
cfg.onUsageLimit.suggest: Offer to switch to the account with the most quota left.
cfg.onUsageLimit.switch: Switch to the account with the most quota left automatically.
cfg.liveQuota: Read each account's 5-hour and weekly usage from Claude Code's status line input. The extension wraps the `statusLine` command in `settings.json` with a script that saves that input and then runs your own status line unchanged; turning this off restores it. Use [Turn live quota on or off](command:claudeAccounts.toggleLiveQuota).
cfg.quotaThreshold: With live quota on, treat an account as at its limit when the 5-hour or weekly usage reaches this percentage, so the switch happens before Claude Code refuses requests. `0` turns this off.
cfg.shareHistory: All accounts use the same conversation history from `~/.claude`. Use [Share history across accounts](command:claudeAccounts.toggleHistorySharing) to turn this on or off: it merges existing history instead of discarding it.
cfg.historyItems: Items treated as history: per-folder conversations (projects), prompt history (history.jsonl), checkpoints (file-history), todos and plans.
cfg.sharedItemsMode: Which items of ~/.claude shared-profile accounts use through links.
cfg.sharedItemsMode.allExcept: Every item of ~/.claude except login data, history, session state and claudeAccounts.sharedItemsExclude. New configuration folders are shared without changing settings.
cfg.sharedItems: Items from `~/.claude` that shared-profile accounts use through links. Login data (`.credentials.json`, `.claude.json`) and session state are never shared, whatever this list says.
cfg.sharedItemsExclude: Items never shared in the `allExcept` mode of `claudeAccounts.sharedItemsMode`.
cfg.shareMcpServers: Copy your user-scope MCP servers (from the Default account's `.claude.json`) into shared-profile accounts. Servers an account defines itself are kept. Add new servers in the Default account.
cfg.applyToTerminal: Also set the account in this window's integrated terminals so the claude CLI uses the same account.
cfg.loginCommand: Command run in the terminal to log in to an account.
cfg.accountsRoot: Folder where accounts are created. Empty = ~/.claude-accounts.
cfg.gravatar: Show the Gravatar of each account's e-mail in the account picker. Off by default: when on, the extension requests images from gravatar.com, sending a hash of the e-mail.
cfg.suggestSwitchOnLimit: Offer to switch accounts when the usage limit is hit.
